items.event_description: Pilot-scale manufacturing of trans-hexahydro-2(3H)-benzoxazolone (trans-HBC) using HheG-catalyzed ring-opening of cyclohexene oxide with NaOCN. Exothermic reaction observed (>35°C), temperature controller used to maintain 25°C. Reaction run for 29 hours to achieve 95% conversion.
items.measurement_points: Temperature monitored during 10 L pilot-scale reaction in 50 L reactor. Exothermic event noted (>35°C), controlled to 25°C.
items.special_treatment: Temperature controller used to maintain 25°C due to exothermic reaction. Cold water recycling for temperature control.

items.event_description: HHDH whole cell screening and small-scale reactions performed at 25°C and 35°C. Screening in 96-well plates at 35°C for 16 hrs. Two-phase reactions and lysate catalysis at room temperature (approx. 25°C).
items.measurement_points: Screening: 96-well plates, 16 hrs at 35°C. Two-phase reactions: 10 mL vials, room temperature (25°C).
items.special_treatment: For lysate catalysis, cells pre-treated with lysozyme at 37°C for 1 hr before reaction at 25°C.

items.event_description: Enzyme tolerance test: Pre-treatment of whole cells with lysozyme at 37°C for 1 hr, then reaction at 25°C for 16 hrs.
items.measurement_points: Pre-treatment at 37°C for 1 hr, then reaction at 25°C for 16 hrs.
items.special_treatment: Lysozyme pre-treatment to obtain soluble enzyme fraction.
